lead: During the rolling year ending November 2026, major flight operations software vendors exhibited robust product updates and customer wins across EFB, flight planning, and dispatch systems, with Jeppesen maintaining the highest volume of captured product launches and Lufthansa Systems capturing significant structural market interest via potential M&A activity.

insights.title: IFS Secures Multiple LCC and Regional Carrier Wins
insights.finding: IFS captured multiple customer deployments for its IFS EFBOne platform, including selections by fastjet and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).
insights.aviation_context: fastjet operates as an African low-cost carrier (LCC), while MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) is classified as an LCC.
insights.caveat: Captured feed visibility reflects public announcements rather than total market share.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Explores Business Unit Divestiture
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems was reportedly exploring the sale of its Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1 billion.
insights.aviation_context: Lido and NetLine form the core flight planning and network management software offerings of Lufthansa Systems.
insights.caveat: Financial press reports regarding M&A discussions are subject to negotiation outcomes.

insights.title: Jeppesen Expands ForeFlight Suite with AI and Hardware Support
insights.finding: Jeppesen released multiple product updates for ForeFlight, including the introduction of AI-enabled Airflow and full support for Apple iPhone Duo.
insights.aviation_context: ForeFlight serves as an EFB platform used across commercial and corporate flight operations.
insights.caveat: Feature rollouts captured in press releases do not quantify active airline user adoption.

insights.title: Navblue Expands Airbus Skywise Footprint with TransNusa
insights.finding: Navblue expanded its collaboration with TransNusa for Skywise Core X2 and Skywise Fleet Performance+ to integrate flight and technical operations.
insights.aviation_context: Skywise integrates digital maintenance and flight operations data for airline fleets.
insights.caveat: Customer wins represent reported public announcements.

insights.title: Aviobook Signs Long-Term Agreement with Royal Air Maroc
insights.finding: Thales subsidiary Aviobook signed a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc to equip its pilots with the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc is a full-service carrier utilizing EFB systems for cockpit digitization.
insights.caveat: Announcements reflect signed contract milestones captured via professional networks.
